bug_summary: RedirectSlashesミドルウェアが`//evil.com/`のようなパスをそのままLocationヘッダに使い、ブラウザがprotocol-relative URLとして解釈してしまうオープンリダイレクト脆弱性を修正
pr_title: Simplify path construction in RedirectSlashes middleware
pr_description: Removes the extra URL parsing step used to rebuild the redirect path, along with the now-unused net/url and strings imports. The trailing-slash redirect now uses the already-computed path directly, keeping the handler shorter and easier to follow.
